question:
The velocity $v$ (in cm/s) of a particle is given in terms of time $t$ (in s) by the equation
$$v = at + \frac{b}{t + c}$$
The dimensions of $a$, $b$ and $c$ are
solution:
Only like quantities can be added, so $c$ has the dimensions of time: $[c] = [T]$.

$at$ is a velocity: $[a] = \dfrac{[LT^{-1}]}{[T]} = [LT^{-2}]$

$\dfrac{b}{t+c}$ is a velocity: $[b] = [LT^{-1}][T] = [L]$
